newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Coast sells $57.5 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Coast sells $57.5 mln of notes.

text.p: Atlantic Coast Airlines Inc said Monday it sold an additional $7.5 million in convertible subordinated notes on top of the $50 million note offering it closed July 2.
The company said the offering's underwriters, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Robertson-Humphrey Co Inc, fully exercised their over-allotment option of $7.5 million in notes.

The airline said the notes, which are due July 1 2004, are non-callable for three years and carry a seven percent annual interest rate. It added noteholders can convert their notes to the company's stock at $18 a share after three years.

Atlantic Coast said it will use the offering's proceeds to support the company's regional jet fleet; buy back 1.46 million of its shares from British Aerospace Plc at a discount; and to pay off high-interest debt.
The airline's stock closed at 16-3/8 Monday, up 1/16 and close to its 52-week high of 17-2/8.
